title: ITC rebounds after GQG's ₹9,395 cr exit

timeline.title: ITC rebounds after GQG's ₹9,395 cr exit
timeline.line: GQG sold a 2.91% stake at ~₹257 a share; Fidelity and ICICI Pru MF were the biggest buyers
more: About 36.5 crore shares changed hands in 14 tranches on Thursday
The stock fell ~4% on Thursday and rose ~2% on Friday
ITC is down about 30% in 2026 on cigarette tax hikes

src.title: Upstox: ITC block deals – GQG sells 2.91% stake for ₹9,395 crore
